job: the lineage of a branch, nearest first, and the checks of a branch: one base with branches for every check

distinct_from.why: Its methodLineage (and the filter of a step's check rows by lineage) moved here as lineageOf and checksOfBranch; method.mjs now imports them and keeps no copy. Its loadMethods resolves extends to build whole method snapshots (steps, backbone, preset), a different job.

Old trillion src/private-method.mjs:25 resolves extends while loading whole methods (the job tools/decide-with-a-method/read-data/method.mjs loadMethods carries); it has no lineage function of its own to move.
This tool's own README, describing lineageOf and checksOfBranch; documentation, not another owner.
A caller: it imports lineageOf from branch.mjs to get a branch lineage over the methods it read; it keeps no lineage code of its own.
The branch tests, calling lineageOf over made-up rows; they test this job, they do not do it.
decide-with-a-method's README: it says a step's checks are those of the method's lineage from this tool's branch.mjs; words about the caller method.mjs, not code.
A held old-trillion file: its own lineageOf(row, rows) answers a workflow's made_from ids and the variations made from it; a recipe's history, not a branch lineage of check rows.
